title: TOXIGEN: A Large-Scale Machine-Generated Dataset for Adversarial and Implicit Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting a large language model (GPT-3) using adversarial decoding (ALICE) to generate implicitly toxic and benign statements mentioning Black, Asian, Native American, Latino, Chinese, Mexican, and Middle Eastern identities, followed by human evaluation and testing against toxicity classifiers.
